# RAGbase Shield common words (English). Written for RAGbase Shield, Apache-2.0.
# Words that are never a name by themselves. Matching is case and accent insensitive.
# Sections (read by ragbase_shield.engine.locale, bundle("en")):
#   [common]   common words that are also frequent surnames (Brown, Hill, Stone, Young): accepted as the
#              surname after a first name or a title, never matched alone; a first name that is also one of
#              these is an "ambiguous" first name (person only with a surname or a cue)
#   [vocab]    capitalised common words (business, HR, legal, IT vocabulary, verbs at a sentence start,
#              headings): never a name word; a one-word company needs a legal form, a suffix or a cue
#   [places]   countries, US states and their abbreviations, large cities of the English-speaking world and
#              of the world: a place alone is never a person or a company; accepted as a surname after a
#              strong first name
#   [acronyms] common business, legal and IT acronyms and stock tickers: never a person; a company only as
#              the acronym of a registered company or after a defined-term marker
